content_zh:
而且在那个年代，道士，阴阳先生，仙婆，神汉，等等都是被人瞧不起的低贱职业，人们对这一类人除了内心有些敬畏以外，大多数是瞧不起，总觉得这些人经常与妖魔鬼怪和死人打交道，是一份极为不吉利的职业。
而且，往往这些人寿命普遍不长，甚至老来不得善终，因为他们一生都是在跟鬼和死人打交到，身上经常沾染了死气，怨气，天长日久，积累下来，不生大病才怪呢。
这都是轻的，严重点的觉得自己道行高深，目中无人，自视甚高，一副老子天下第一的姿态，为了几个钱，不知死活的出去帮苦主降妖伏魔，没成想最后碰到硬茬子了，没几下就被对方收拾掉，最终落得个英年早逝的凄惨下场。
与我妈一样，我爸也沉默了，显然老头的要求有些过分，如果要不是为了救我，说不定他上去就给老头一个大耳刮子，我李国华好不容易生个儿子，一把屎一把尿，辛辛苦苦拉扯大，你一句话就随你去学道？
老头见我父母不吭声，就笑眯眯的说道:“唉，二位呀，实不相瞒，这孩子天生就是通灵体质，生下来就该做道士，如若不然，此生必定病魔带身，受到百鬼纠缠，要是没有我道家僻佑，性命堪忧，可惜，可惜啊。”
说完，他仰着脑袋，眼睛瞄着我家屋顶，也不知道在看什么，而且还摆出一脸的痛心之色，时不时唉声叹气，好像我要是不做道士，可能随时快要挂掉一样，那吊欠揍模样，任谁见了，都恨不得上去呼他两巴掌。
“蒋师傅，难道就没有别的办法，双喜非得做道士吗？我李国华可就这一个儿子啊，双喜要是当了道士，我李家的香火可就从我这断了，我怎么有脸去见列祖列宗啊。”我爸一听老头说的这么严重，顿时失了方寸，急的那是额头直冒汗。
老头美滋滋的吸了一口烟，摇头晃脑的说并无其他办法，天生通灵体质之人前世便是修道之人，因为某些原因或接受任务下凡历练，这一世注定就该做一个道士，只有这样，方能避免病魔缠身，百鬼骚扰。
我妈一听，抱着我就呜呜的大哭了起来，直喊着自己的命苦怎么这么苦哇，好不容易生了一个儿子还得出家做道士，我上辈子是做了什么虐啊。
老头看我爸妈一脸的灰败之色，好像有点良心发现，于心不忍了，话音一转，和颜悦色的说:“哭个啥子嘛，我还没说完呢，你们二人不必担心传宗接代的问题，我所属的门派就剩下我一个人，我派也没有道士不能结婚生子的规定，待你家孩子随我学道有成，延续我派道统以后，在结婚生子，为李家在续香火也不是不可以。”
听了老头说完这些，我爸妈脸色才好看了一些，虽说心里还有些不愿意，不过见我昏迷不醒，为了救我，犹豫了一下，也只好勉强答应老头的要求了。
老头见我爸妈同意，当即开怀一笑，不过那声音笑的阴险，笑得奸诈，如同一只阴谋得逞的老狐狸。
“说说吧，孩子的名字，还有八字是多少？我算算这小子跑多远了。”老头吸了口烟，漫不经心的对我爸妈问道。
我妈一听，连忙把我的名字和生辰八字，一字不漏的说了出来。
“李双喜是吧，名字不错，听着就喜庆，你们两口子挺会起名字的嘛。”老头夸奖我爸妈一句，伸出手指，掐算起来。
过了少许，老头放下手，自言自语道：“管说黄老二这厮不敢去，双喜小子魂去的地方还真是够远的，以目前情况看来，招魂肯定是行不通了，为今之计，只有老夫亲自去把他给接回来才行。”
老头挑了挑眉毛，想了想之后，便吩咐我爸妈赶快去找来彩纸，剪刀，浆糊，毛笔，竹子，还有檀香等一系列物品。
他一吩咐下来，我爸妈哪儿敢怠慢，迅速的忙活起来，争分夺秒的翻出这些东西，因为赶得急，回来的时候我妈还差点摔了一跤，可见救我之心急切。
当他们把所有物品集齐后，老头命令我爸用刀子把竹子划开，做成一条一条的。

content_en:
Moreover, in that era, Taoist priests, Yin-Yang Masters, fairy women, divine men, etc. were all low-level professions that were looked down upon by others. In addition to being a little awe-stricken, most people looked down upon these people. They always felt that these people often dealt with monsters, ghosts, and the dead, which was an extremely unlucky profession.
Moreover, these people often do not live long, or even end well in old age, because they have been dealing with ghosts and dead people all their lives, and their bodies are often contaminated with the energy of death and resentment, which accumulate over time, so it would be strange if they did not get seriously ill.
These are all minor. In more serious cases, they feel that they are profound, arrogant, and have a high self-esteem. For a few money, they go out to help the sufferer subjugate demons regardless of life and death. Unexpectedly, they end up encountering a tough problem, and are dealt with by the other party within a few moments. Finally, they end up dying young.
Like my mother, my father also fell silent. Obviously the old man's request was a bit excessive. If he hadn't come up to save me, he might have given the old man a big slap in the face. I, Li Guohua, finally gave birth to a son.
When the old man saw that my parents were silent, he smiled and said, "Hey, you two, let me tell you the truth. This child was born with a psychic constitution. He should be a Taoist priest when he was born. If not, he will be riddled with diseases and haunted by hundreds of ghosts in his life. Without my Taoist blessing, his life will be in trouble. What a pity, what a pity."
After saying that, he raised his head and stared at the roof of my house. He didn't know what he was looking at. He also put on a sad look on his face. He sighed from time to time, as if I might die at any time if I didn't become a Taoist priest. He looked like he was hanging around and wanted to be beaten. Anyone who saw it would want to go up and slap him twice.
"Master Jiang, is there no other way? Does Shuangxi have to become a Taoist priest? I, Li Guohua, only have this son. If Shuangxi becomes a Taoist priest, the incense of my Li family will be cut off from me. How can I have the nerve to meet my ancestors?" When my father heard what the old man said was so serious, he suddenly lost his composure, and he was so anxious that sweat broke out on his forehead.
The old man took a puff of the cigarette happily, shook his head and said that there was no other way. People who were born with psychic physiques were Taoist monks in their previous lives. Due to some reasons or acceptance of tasks, they were destined to be Taoist priests in this life. Only in this way can they avoid being plagued by diseases and being harassed by hundreds of ghosts.
When my mother heard this, she started crying loudly while holding me in her arms, shouting that her life was so miserable. After finally giving birth to a son, she still had to become a Taoist priest. What kind of abuse did I do in my previous life?
The old man looked at the dejected look on my parents' faces, and seemed to have some conscience. He couldn't bear it any more. He changed his tone and said in a pleasant tone: "Why are you crying? I haven't finished speaking yet. You two don't have to worry about continuing the family line. I I am the only one left in the sect that I belong to, and there is no rule in our sect that Taoist priests cannot get married and have children. After your children have successfully learned Taoism from me and continued the Taoist tradition of my sect, it is not impossible for them to get married and have children, so as to continue the legacy of the Li family. "
After hearing what the old man said, my parents looked a little better. Although they were still a little reluctant, they saw that I was unconscious and in order to save me, they hesitated and had to reluctantly agree to the old man's request.
When the old man saw that my parents agreed, he immediately laughed heartily, but the laughter sounded sinister and treacherous, like an old fox who had succeeded in his conspiracy.
"Tell me, what is the child's name and horoscope? Let me calculate how far this kid has run." The old man took a puff of cigarette and asked my parents casually.
When my mother heard this, she quickly told me my name and birth date, word for word.
"Li Shuangxi, right? It's a good name. It sounds festive. You two are pretty good at naming." The old man praised my parents, stretched out his fingers, and counted.Come.
After a while, the old man put down his hand and said to himself: "Although Huang Laoer dare not go, the place where Shuangxi boy's soul went is really far away. Judging from the current situation, summoning the soul is definitely not feasible. For the current plan, I can only go and bring him back in person."
The old man raised his eyebrows, and after thinking for a while, he ordered my parents to quickly find colored paper, scissors, paste, writing brushes, bamboo, sandalwood and a series of other items.
As soon as he gave the order, my parents didn't dare to neglect. They quickly got busy and raced against time to dig out these things. Because they were in a hurry, my mother almost fell when she came back, which showed that she was eager to save me.
When they gathered all the items, the old man ordered my dad to cut the bamboo into strips with a knife.
